handoff: Approve on the current HEAD (after merging main c207e7c01): O2a's rerun at the failed check and run view's check_retry do what gh-213 asks, B50 is kept, the merge resolution is sound, test#2 is green. 3 minor findings: run view observes on every call; the code_changed:null branch and markdown line are untested; LOG_LIMIT counts merged base commits.

findings.title: run view runs a full local observe on every call
findings.detail:
`localUnit(ctx, key)` calls `observe(ctx, { sync: 'never' })` for every `run view <unit>`, even for a unit that no check's fail sent back. This adds git, process and runner probes to a command that used to only read files. It is not wrong, just slower.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Read the unit's state with loadLocalFacts first, and observe only when `checkRetryOf` is non-null.

findings.title: code_changed: null branch and the markdown line are untested
findings.detail:
No test covers the case with no worktree or no boundary commit, where `code_changed` is null and run view prints 'unknown'. No test covers the markdown line run view adds either. The JSON true/false path is proven by the run-rerun-check integration test.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add one integration assertion with the boundary commit missing, and one on the markdown text.

findings.title: LOG_LIMIT 200 counts merged-in base commits
findings.detail:
`git.log(wt.path, 'HEAD', 200)` walks both parents. After a base merge that brings in more than about 200 commits, the fail's boundary commit falls outside the window and `code_changed` becomes null. This errs on the safe side (the supervisor leaves the unit alone), and base merges rarely happen while implement runs.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Walk first-parent only, or document the limit.
